quick_skim.title: A new formulation of Discontinuous Galerkin method for interface capturing approaches
quick_skim.abstract: In computational fluid dynamics, the numerical simulation of free-surface flows using interface capturing approaches (level set, pseudo-concentration) requires accurate resolution of a transport equation. In the present work, this equation is solved using a new formulation of the Lesaint--Raviart discontinuous Galerkin method, which is particularly suitable for problems without inflow boundaries. The motion is described by the incompressible Navier--Stokes equations with surface tension, discretized using the standard $P2-P1$ Taylor--Hood finite element method in space. Surface tension effects are represented using the so-called Continuum Surface Force model. Finally, the proposed approach is implemented and tested on several benchmarks, including the single rising bubble and the Rayleigh--Taylor instability.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: develops a discontinuous Galerkin interface capturing method for free-surface flows, applicable to multiphase CFD such as falling film simulation

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: The paper presents a new discontinuous Galerkin formulation for interface capturing in free-surface flow simulations, using level set or pseudo-concentration transport and surface tension via continuum surface force. Benchmarks show its suitability for multiphase CFD problems like falling films.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对自由表面流界面捕捉问题，本文提出一种新的间断伽辽金方法，用于求解无入流边界问题的输运方程。该方法结合不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程与表面张力模型（连续表面力），采用P2-P1 Taylor-Hood有限元离散。通过基准测试验证了该方法对多相流CFD（如降膜流动模拟）的适用性。该工作为降膜换热的数值模拟提供了可借鉴的界面处理方法。

quick_skim.title: Micro-convection mass transfer following bubble coalescence on a solid wall
quick_skim.abstract: The Volume-of-Fluid implementation in the \href{basilisk.fr}{Basilisk} flow solver is employed to study mass transfer after coalescence-induced jump-off of bubbles on solid substrates at four combinations of bubble radius ($R_m=150$ and 25 $μ$m, hydrogen-water properties) and Schmidt number ($\text{Sc}=210$ and 1). The results show a relatively strong downward entrainment of low-concentration liquid, induced by a rapid movement of the bubble interface at approximately 0.5 to 1 inertio-capillary time units after the moment of coalescence. At $\text{Sc}=210$, this leads to a highly local increase of the Sherwood number at a core region (roughly an area of radius $R_m/2$) below the south pole of the merged bubble, which persists long after the bubble departure due to the slow diffusion at large $\text{Sc}$. The enhancement factor of the Sherwood number is highly dependent on the state of the mass-transfer boundary layer at the moment of coalescence, increasing with smaller boundary layer thicknesses. Shortly after the jump-off, the velocity of the bubble is considerably damped and rapidly approaches its free-rise terminal velocity. The effect of micro-convection on the wall mass transfer coefficient at this stage is insignificant when isolated, similar to what is reported in the literature for purely buoyancy-driven bubble rise -- but slightly stronger.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Uses Basilisk's Volume-of-Fluid method to simulate mass transfer after bubble coalescence on solid substrates, revealing a strong downward entrainment that locally enhances Sherwood number.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对气泡在固体壁面上聚并后的质量传递问题，该文利用Basilisk中的Volume-of-Fluid方法进行数值模拟。研究发现，聚并后气泡界面的快速运动引起低浓度液体的强烈向下卷吸，在气泡下方核心区域显著提高舍伍德数。这一结果揭示了微对流对质量传递的增强机制，对多相流传质模拟具有重要意义。
